title: More ways to explore Rivian locations
changes: Explore Charging and Rivian Places in separate views, with distinct filters and map symbols for each location type.
Find charging prices, connector types, charging speeds, and individual port details where available, with color-coded ratings beside location names.
Browse location details with a close button that stays visible as you scroll. Closing details returns to the full map overview.
Find nearby locations with the new crosshairs control, and save places for later.
Location information refreshes automatically, with dated charger issue reports available in location details.
